### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #31512

Problem Summary:
Support escaped schema/table name in source file for the default file-routing rules. 

NOTE: we only apply an unescape for schema/table name for the default rules, so it can be compatible with dumpling. For customized rules, we leave this responsibility to the user to user the extract names are correct.
